label: Desktop app (Windows / macOS / Linux)
summary: Installed desktop software with windows, menus and shortcuts

options.question: Native menu bar and keyboard shortcuts?

preview_screen: The main window with title bar, toolbar or sidebar, and the primary working area.
design_guidance: Follow each chosen operating system's window controls and title bar placement.
Every important action has a keyboard shortcut shown in menus and tooltips.
Show dense, efficient layouts; hover and focus states matter because the pointer is the main input.

checks: The minimum window size is designed and no primary action is clipped at it.
Window controls and title bar follow the conventions of each chosen operating system.
Primary actions list a keyboard shortcut, and focus order is logical.
Destructive actions and unsaved-changes situations confirm.
